messages:
lee: Quick spitball  who wants a midweek 'indie swap & speedrun' night next Wed? low-key, BYO rig or controller.

noor: i'm in if it's casual. maybe 6:30 start so folks can eat first.

ben: love this. can we do a tiny 'best glitch' prize? :laughing:

izzy: please yes. also can we do a 3-game rotation so people can hop in/out.

lee: plan idea: 3 rounds (short indie runs), scoreboard on a sheet, small prize (steam key or company swag). one-key-per-person rule.

patch-bot: Note: mezzanine availability checked  6:30pm-10pm confirmed.

noor: poll? time: 6pm/6:30pm/7pm

poll-bot: POLL by noor  "Indie swap start time" Options: "6pm", "6:30pm", "7pm". Votes: Noor (6:30pm), Ben (6:30pm), Izzy (6pm), Lee (6:30pm).

ben: snack plan: finger-food only. no greasy hands on controllers.

izzy: i'll bring hand wipes + a 4-port USB hub. someone remind me to label it.

lee: remote folks: we'll stream the main screen to a call and run a remote raffle for two keys.

noor: if people bring decks/deck-alikes please sign on the sheet so we don't double-up.

ben: also background music playlist? low volume, 80s chiptune? i can queue something.

izzy: adding a tiny 'speedrun rules' note: no glitches unless the category allows it. be kind.

lee: i'll hide 4 mystery keys around the mezz area with tiny riddles. winners DM me.

noor: can we limit entries to current Redwood employees? remote contractors included?

lee: yes current Redwood employees + contractors on payroll. no bots. :robot_face:

patch-bot: FYI: please do not move server racks. Keep networking gear stationary.

izzy: last thing: anyone needs a controller? I have one PS4 and one Xbox wireless dongle.

ben: i'll take the PS4 one if noor doesn't.

noor: i'll bring a small prize (company sticker pack + candy) for the 'best glitch' winner.

lee: great. final: keep volume reasonable after 9:30pm, clean up after. see you Wed!
